selection: Same saved daily entries, budgets, six exits and four scales. Require positive 5%/10%-cost training returns and the named training drawdown ceiling; maximize the 10%-cost return. Each identity family may select unmodified sizing or cash. Ties retain catalog order.
scope: Retrospective caller-history comparison on already examined dates. Caller statistics use only previous-day completed other-token outcomes, with explicit identity attribution and shrinkage. No post-hoc caller blacklist, no wallet identity inference, no change to frozen validation rules.
